result.title: MIMORPHEUS: Rethinking Cross-Modal Supervision for Human Pose Estimation from Radar Signals
result.summary: Deep learning has shown promise for estimating human pose with multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar through walls. Building paired radar and pose datasets demands considerable time and manual effort, while large visual pose datasets provide no corresponding radar echoes. Physical simulation can supply synthetic signals, but requires expertise in scattering models and can leave a gap between simulated and real data. To address this challenge, we introduce MIMORPHEUS, a framework that generates radar echoes from 3D human poses through conditional diffusion. To prepare echo and pose representations, MIMO-VAE compresses the echoes according to their channel and fast time sample structure, while SkeleCoder learns pose features through contrastive alignment with echo features. These pose features then guide diffusion in the MIMO-VAE latent space, and the VAE decoder reconstructs echoes from the generated latents. Once trained, the generator augments radar data by producing different echoes for a recorded pose and supplies the radar modality for pose annotations in existing visual datasets. In data augmentation experiments, our method reduces MPJPE by 6.8%-11.2% across four radar pose estimators. Transfer experiments with three public pose datasets also show that visual pose annotations can supply useful radar training data. Code will be made publicly available on GitHub.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MIMORPHEUS，先用 MIMO-VAE 压缩雷达回波、用 SkeleCoder 通过对比对齐学习人体姿态特征，再以姿态特征为条件在回波 latent 空间做条件扩散，从而由 3D 姿态生成雷达回波以扩充训练数据。
AI.relevance_reason: 领域较远且无推理轨迹或停止决策，但「对比对齐的语义特征作为 latent 生成条件」这一设计可供核查 LVR 中如何让 latent 状态承载任务必要信息以及如何监督其对齐质量。
